children: Sono Group entered into a Share Purchase Agreement with private purchasers to issue 283,500 ordinary shares, priced at the prior day's consolidated closing bid on Nasdaq. The offering is registered on the company's effective Form S-3 shelf, with a prospectus supplement to follow. Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, subject to restrictions on debt repayment, share redemptions, and litigation settlements. Issuances are capped at 19.9% of voting power or outstanding shares under Nasdaq rules.
